title: Bug: sonic-slave-bookworm Dockerfile fails on `cargo install cargo-tarpaulin`
author: kkosciuszkiewicz-arista
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

Installation of `cargo-tarpaulin` fails during build of the sonic-slave-bookworm docker image.

The problem seems to be caused by a recently updated [ruzstd](https://crates.io/crates/ruzstd) package, which is an indirect dependency of `cargo-tarpaulin`:

```
ruzstd v0.8.2
└── object v0.37.3
    └── cargo-tarpaulin v0.34.1
```

ruzstd v0.8.2 (released on November 2nd) is using [is_multiple_of](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/std/primitive.usize.html#method.is_multiple_of) method on unsigned numbers, which is only available since `rustc` 1.87.0. Older versions of `rustc` raise an error when compiling code using this method:
```
error[E0658]: use of unstable library feature `unsigned_is_multiple_of`
```

This error is emitted when building `sonic-slave-bookworm` docker image.

### Steps to Reproduce

Failing command: `BLDENV=bookworm make -f Makefile.work configure` ran in `sonic-buildimage` directory.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Build of `sonic-slave-bookworm` is expected to complete without errors.

### Relevant log output

```shell
#68 4.969 error[E0658]: use of unstable library feature `unsigned_is_multiple_of`
#68 4.969   --> /root/.cargo/registry/src/index.crates.io-1949cf8c6b5b557f/ruzstd-0.8.2/src/bit_io/bit_reader.rs:69:30
#68 4.969    |
#68 4.969 69 |             assert!(self.idx.is_multiple_of(8));
#68 4.969    |                              ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
#68 4.969    |
#68 4.969    = note: see issue #128101 <https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/128101> for more information

...

 > [64/66] RUN /usr/.cargo/bin/cargo install cargo-tarpaulin:
5.139    Compiling gzip-header v1.0.0
5.172    Compiling tracing-log v0.2.0
5.218    Compiling clap_builder v4.5.51
5.259    Compiling deflate v1.0.0
5.292    Compiling http v1.3.1
5.351 For more information about this error, try `rustc --explain E0658`.
5.356 error: could not compile `ruzstd` (lib) due to 8 previous errors
5.356 warning: build failed, waiting for other jobs to finish...
11.31 error: failed to compile `cargo-tarpaulin v0.34.1`, intermediate artifacts can be found at `/tmp/cargo-install5uUK78`.
11.31 To reuse those artifacts with a future compilation, set the environment variable `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` to that path.
------
Dockerfile:566
--------------------
 564 |
 565 |     # Install cargo-tarpaulin for code coverage
 566 | >>> RUN $RUST_ROOT/bin/cargo install cargo-tarpaulin
 567 |
 568 |     RUN post_run_buildinfo sonic-slave-bookworm
--------------------
ERROR: failed to solve: process "/bin/sh -c $RUST_ROOT/bin/cargo install cargo-tarpaulin" did not complete successfully: exit code: 101
```

### Output of `show version`, `show techsupport`

```shell
Not applicable.
```

_No response_

linkedPullRequests.title: Fix cargo-tarpaulin install in sonic-slave-bookworm
linkedPullRequests.author: kkosciuszkiewicz-arista
linkedPullRequests.body:
Package ruzstd is a transitive dependency of cargo-tarpaulin. ruzstd v0.8.2 was released on 2025-11-02, and it uses new api `is_multiple_of` that has been stabilised and released in rust 1.87.0. This method is marked as unstable in older rust versions, and hence fails the build of sonic-slave-bookworm.

Use frozen dependencies from `Cargo.lock` when installing `cargo-tarpaulin`.
